reason: The necessity claim 'Uniqueness can compare two candidates only after both are shown to be inverses of the same map with the same source and target' is false and reintroduces the overstatement already corrected in validated node 1.7.5.2. Since 1.7.4 makes Pi_delta injective, to identify u_grp(X)=u_pol(X) at a relevant X it suffices that u_grp(X) lies in calU and that some h_X in B_delta^{calH}(J) satisfies Pi_delta(u_grp(X),h_X)=X; comparison with the unique preimage (u_pol(X),h_pol(X)) then gives equality of first components, without u_grp being part of any global two-sided inverse. Pointwise synchronization only at X=U bold-dot V and X=U^dagger would already suffice for transport. The externals may indeed fail to supply even this weaker condition, but node 1.7.7's stated 'only after both are shown to be inverses' inference is materially too strong and must be amended to the pointwise criterion.
